reviewer: Independent Astra Max native source and anatomical registration reviewer
scope: Four exact native Union A southwest direction 3 and Confederate A northeast direction 7 contact/casualty sources and their sixteen independently reviewed registrations. Integration, playback and exact installation acceptance remain separate.
frameOrder: Equal native cells in row-major order: upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, lower-right.
referenceMethod: For each army, independently select four cap-crown-only and nearer-support-sole-only ROIs on its actual contact source. At alpha>=64 take capTop as minimum occupied Y and soleGroundY as exclusive maximum occupied Y. BodySpan=soleGroundY-capTop; use the half-up median of four contact spans. Share that single army reference unchanged with its casualty source. Natural crouch, thrust and fall projection changes are not normalized.
rootMethod: Select native integer root X from projected pelvis/torso anatomy independently of ground ROI X. Root Y is the exclusive alpha>=64 maximum in the bounded near boot, palm, knee, forearm or upper-leg support ROI. Whole silhouette and weapon bounds are not the selection method.
rootPlacementUncertaintyNativePixels: Approximately 6–10 pixels for anatomical projection and support interpretation. Recorded ROI extrema are reproducible; semantic body support remains a model-assisted visual judgment.

groundMethods: Projected pelvis X selected independently. Ground Y is the alpha>=64 exclusive bottom of the nearer viewer-left/front boot sole, isolated below the trouser cuff; no rifle pixels.
Projected pelvis X follows the hips behind the forward lean. Ground Y comes from the nearer forward boot sole during the short SW extension, independently of the other boot and weapon.
Projected pelvis X follows the withdrawn torso/hips. Ground Y comes from the nearer viewer-left boot sole under the recovering leg.
Projected pelvis X follows the wide guard hips. Ground Y comes from the nearer viewer-left planted boot sole; the wider stance lowers projected body height naturally.

pairAssessment.union: Exact contact/casualty sources keep coherent head, roll, coat, boot and limb proportions across eight cells. Contact spans 418/407/399/367 yield reference 403. Lower wide-guard and fallen projections are intentional.
pairAssessment.confederate: New ccb contact and reinstated 4f67 casualty are coherent in head/roll/torso/boot scale. Contact spans 370/366/361/347 yield reference 364. Casualty first-pose projection is similar; knee/prone changes are natural. No separate casualty scaling or older contact median.
pairAssessment.relativeGameScale: Body-relative head/kit/limb proportions are coherent with actual renderer references and reviewed cardinal style. Each army uses its own fresh contact median. This is source judgment, not actual v25 browser validation.

limitations: Native RGBA bytes remain unchanged. Low-alpha colored fringe/noise persists and some nonzero-alpha bounds reach cell edges. Alpha>=64 padding passes but does not certify fringe-free pixels.
Rear Confederate grip/rifle continuity is partly hidden. Revised thrust is a distinct contact extension, but hidden joints/fingers and exact historical drill are not certified.
Initial Confederate casualty reaction is restrained alone. Four still phases do not establish smooth motion, continuous planted-foot trajectories or every transition.
Natural pose projection varies without individual resizing. Roots/support semantics are visual judgments rather than physical skeletal reconstruction.
V25 browser/gameplay integration, compact readability, dense-rank occlusion and device/GPU behavior are outside this source-only decision.
Other diagonal bearings, Union B contact/casualty, contact spacing and the complete family remain unfinished. No default, production, human, anatomy or historical certification.
